verify_before_render: LTX-2.5 released 2026-08-11: 22B open-weights video+audio 'world' model; a 10-second image-to-video render in 6.8 s on 2xGB200 (about 23.7 s through the API); native multishot with consistent characters and voice; diffusion decoder; Gemma 4 12B encoder; LTX-2.x Community Licence (free below $10M revenue; NOT an OSI licence); ComfyUI support from day one; the family has passed 33M downloads. The HF card is gated (auth) — the product page ltx.io/model/ltx-2-5 is the capture surface. Do not invent pricing.

Region names used here exist in captures/tool-ltx25-01/manifest.json and sit inside the desktop-top viewport (y+h <= 900 CSS): title_ltx-2-5-a-stronger-foundation-fo {305,171,669,127}, btn_download-open-weights {441,407,262,47}, btn_try-now {719,407,121,47}. All other harvested regions sit deeper than the fold and must not be used in page scenes.
No on-screen credit captions. Option 3 Chatterbox Michael continuous-flow voice required.

scenes.heading: ONE MODEL, VIDEO *AND* AUDIO
scenes.say: {LTX 2.5|LTX two point five} is a twenty two billion parameter video model that generates sound too — and you can take the weights home.
The page calls it a stronger foundation, and you can download the open weights straight from the hero.
scenes.heading: A STRONGER *FOUNDATION*
WHAT *CHANGED* IN 2.5
steps: Auto duration, better results per compute
scenes.say: Version two point five brings native multi-shot with consistent characters and voice, cleaner motion, stronger prompt adherence, auto duration, and post-production tools — refine, restore, even SDR to HDR.

scenes.heading: TEN SECONDS IN *6.8*
scenes.label: image-to-video on 2×GB200 · ~23.7 s via API
scenes.say: An image to a ten second clip in six point eight seconds on two GB200s. Through the API, about twenty four.

scenes.heading: *22 BILLION* PARAMETERS, OPEN WEIGHTS
scenes.label: video + audio · diffusion decoder · Gemma 4 12B encoder
scenes.say: Twenty two billion parameters, open weights, with a diffusion decoder and a Gemma four twelve B text encoder.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
cons: GB200-class GPUs for the fast path
pros: Video plus audio in one model
scenes.say: The catches: the licence is community, not OSI; free only under ten million dollars revenue; and the fast path wants GB200 class GPUs. The good: open weights, video and audio in one model, and ComfyUI support from day one.
Would you run this one locally? Comment LTX and I will pin the model page.

youtube.title: LTX 2.5: Open-Weights Video + Audio in One Model
youtube.description:
LTX-2.5 (released 11 August 2026) is a 22B open-weights video and audio model: a 10-second image-to-video clip renders in 6.8 s on 2xGB200 (~23.7 s via API), with native multi-shot, consistent characters and voice, a diffusion decoder and a Gemma 4 12B encoder. The LTX-2.x Community Licence is free below $10M revenue but is not an OSI licence; ComfyUI support arrived day one; the model family has passed 33M downloads.
Source: https://ltx.io/model/ltx-2-5
